title: ConflictOfInterestDeclaration
description: PACK-09, ADR-042. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.ConflictOfInterestDeclaration). A conflict of interest is represented as an EXPLICIT STATE, never as free text that has no effect on the workflow (PACK-09 required invariant 10): 'declared' and 'confirmed' both make the party ineligible to take a separated procedural role or to record a decision. basis_code is a short closed-vocabulary marker; any human narrative lives in a referenced document under PACK-11, never here. A 'confirmed' or 'waived' declaration must record who decided it and when. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
